port.ask: Serial port of the carrier board the EZO circuit sits on (COM7, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: An Atlas USB carrier or any 3.3/5 V USB-serial adapter wired to the circuit's TX/RX. The circuit must be in UART mode (green LED at rest).

circuit.ask: Which EZO circuit is on this port
circuit.help: Recorded so the person installing knows which reading signal (ph, orp, dissolved_oxygen, conductivity, temperature) is the real one; the driver does not switch on it. The circuit_info signal (command i) confirms it.
